# A raise in a render reaches the boundary around what rendered, on every
# target: a loop's list, a prop's value, at the first draw and again when a
# write elsewhere asks for the render. The boundary around the button whose
# click made the write hears nothing, since the click did nothing wrong; the
# call that raised is its type's zero value, and the render goes on.
#
# No target caught one: the checker resolved no call in a view's expressions,
# so a Go build panicked, a page raised it uncaught, android's composition
# threw, and the interpreter and bubbletea dropped it. Confirmed against the
# codegen before: every case below failed on every target.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '^ok +5 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '^ok +5 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +5 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +5 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +5 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '^ok +5 tests, 0 failures$'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func labels(n int) list[string] {
    if n == 1 {
        error.raise("one is refused", "bad")
    }
    return ["n{n}"]
}

func label(n int) string {
    if n == 1 {
        error.raise("one is refused", "bad")
    }
    return "n{n}"
}

component split ui.node {
    var n = 0
    var saveError = ""
    var listError = ""
    boundary(@error(e) {
        saveError = e.message
    }) {
        ui.button #add(text="Add", @click {
            n += 1
        })
    }
    boundary(@error(e) {
        listError = e.message
    }) {
        for var l = labels(n) {
            ui.text #shown(value=l)
        }
        ui.text #single(value=label(n))
    }
}

component first ui.node {
    var n = 1
    var listError = ""
    boundary(@error(e) {
        listError = e.message
    }) {
        for var l = labels(n) {
            ui.text(value=l)
        }
    }
}

component fallback ui.node {
    var n = 0
    boundary {
        ui.text #content(value=label(n))
        component failed {
            ui.text(value="could not draw")
        }
    }
    ui.button #step(text="step", @click {
        n += 1
    })
}

func testTheRenderNotTheClickHearsIt(t Test, c split) {
    c.add.click()
    t.assert(c.n == 1)
    t.assert(c.listError == "one is refused")
    t.assert(c.saveError == "")
}

func testTheRenderGoesOn(t Test, c split) {
    t.assert(c.single.value == "n0")
    c.add.click()
    c.add.click()
    t.assert(c.shown[0] != null && c.shown[0].value == "n2")
    t.assert(c.single.value == "n2")
}

func testAPropsValueIsItsZero(t Test, c split) {
    c.add.click()
    t.assert(c.single.value == "")
}

func testTheFirstDrawIsHeard(t Test, c first) {
    t.assert(c.listError == "one is refused")
}

func testTheFallbackStands(t Test, c fallback) {
    t.assert(c.content != null)
    c.step.click()
    t.assert(c.content == null)
}

ui.window {
    split
}
